dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh... Why is this dog named Fishie?

dialogues.speaker: Patricia
dialogues.text: Well, my goldfish is named Puppy, so this one became Fishie.

dialogues.speaker: Patricia
dialogues.text: But actually, Fishie beats Puppy. Out of everything in the world, it's the third-dearest to me, right after my parents.
